from decimal import Decimal
from app.money import money_total
assert money_total(["1.005"]) == Decimal("1.01"), "round half up, not binary/bankers rounding"
assert money_total(["0.1", "0.2"]) == Decimal("0.30")
assert money_total([]) == Decimal("0.00")
assert isinstance(money_total(["1"]), Decimal)
print("acceptance: passed")

def money_total(values):
    return round(sum(float(v) for v in values), 2)
